approach: Gaelco 3D MC68EC020, TMS320C31 geometry DSP and ADSP-2115 sound programs statically translated to C; the polygons drawn by GX on the Wii
notes: Runs natively on a real Wii, launched with the Homebrew Channel. Sideways Wii Remote with tilt steering, Classic Controller and GameCube controller; rumble; optional widescreen; 480p.
